subject: Request: hosted API volume pricing and custom quote for 1B tokens/month
messages:
From: Jordan Ames <procurement@acme.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: hosted API volume pricing for 1B tokens/month

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for connecting last week. Acme AI is evaluating hosted inference for a large-scale feature rollout and we need a clear baseline and a custom quote for ~1 billion tokens / month (peak windows up to ~1200 tokens/sec). Can you send:

- Your standard hosted API rate card (per-token or per-1k token pricing)
- Any published volume discount bands and how overage pricing works
- Whether there are preferred models or SKUs for sustained throughput (latency SLO: 95th %ile < 250ms)
- Options for committed volume pricing vs pay-as-you-go, billing cadence, and prepayment discounts

We are also happy to share expected monthly ramp numbers if helpful. Ultimately we need a formal quote and a DocuSign-ready order form for procurement.

Thanks,
Jordan Ames
Procurement, Acme AI
---
Acme AI contact: procurement@acme.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Ames <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T13:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API volume pricing for 1B tokens/month

Jordan — thanks for the note and the clear ask. I attached our standard ratecard and a quick workbook with a first-pass estimate for 1B/月 so you have numbers to work with. High-level first pass below; we should block a 30-minute call to go line-by-line and collect your ramp/latency profile.

Baseline (hosted API, standard models) — list prices (per token):
- Base (pay-as-you-go): $0.00060 / token (equivalent to $0.60 per 1k tokens)
- Volume tier guidance (hosted commit pricing, applied to tokens consumed during billing month):
  - 0 — 100M tokens: list price
  - 100M — 500M: 18% discount off list
  - 500M — 1B: 30% discount off list
  - 1B+ : custom pricing (we typically structure 30–40% off list depending on commitment, latency SLO, and regional egress)

Examples (for orientation):
- 1B tokens/month @ hosted commit (no reserved GPUs): effective per token ~ $0.00042 (assuming 30% off) -> $420k / month
- If you need strict 95p latency SLOs and dedicated capacity, we recommend Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) — pricing is different (capacity commitment + reduced per-token unit cost) and supports guaranteed throughput windows.

Commercial mechanics / options we typically offer:
- Monthly committed volume (hosted): monthly true-up; overage billed at next tier or at list if no commit
- 12-month prepay: additional 5% discount on top of tier pricing
- Ramp schedule allowed (we model a 90-day linear ramp with an agreed min starting commit)
- Early-exit credits and true-up mechanics in the SOW

Operational levers to reduce unit cost (technical):
- KV/prefix caching and prefix sampling to cut repeat token volume
- Smart batching and streaming to minimize context re-sends
- Model-variant routing: fall back to cheaper quantized variants for non-critical calls

Next steps:
1) Please confirm target monthly tokens and a 3-month ramp plan (if you have it)
2) Tell me the target latency SLO and peak tokens/sec profile
3) I’ll put together a formal quote (DocuSign ready) including prepay and reserved options — cc'ing sales & finance to help scope a clean quote.

Attaching: Redwood_Standard_Ratecard_v1.pdf; Acme_Estimate_2026-12-01.xlsx (workbook is a stub with tier math).

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Ben/Marcus — forwarding Acme's request (below). They asked for a hosted quote for ~1B tokens/month and need a DocuSign-ready order form.

Key context: 95p latency target <250ms (they called that out), peak ~1200 t/s, prefer hosted but open to dedicated if latency guarantees require it. They also asked about prepay and billing cadence.

Can you:
- Draft a hosted commit quote (monthly commit + 12m commit options) with a prepay line and an alternate Dedicated quote if you think it's materially better for their SLOs
- Propose payment terms (net30 typical), prepay discount (we usually do 5% for annual up-front), and a ramp phasing option (we typically allow Q1 ramp with true-up)
- Assign a provisional deal id; I put DEAL-2026-1157 in the header to use for HubSpot.

I attached the standard ratecard and my quick estimate. Happy to jump on a call with you and Jordan if useful.

— Soojin
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: hosted API volume pricing for 1B tokens/month

Adding a draft commercial structure below for internal review. Marcus/Rishi — please validate the math and confirm approval to issue a formal quote.

Option 1 — Hosted Commit (recommended if they want minimal ops):
- Term: 12 months
- Monthly committed tokens: 1B tokens/month (phased ramp allowed across first 3 months)
- Unit pricing (post-tier discounts): $0.00042 / token (30% off list)
- Overage: billed at tiered overage rate (next tier) or at list if they exhaust the top-tier; include 30-day grace for ramp
- Prepay annual (1x): additional 5% off net pricing
- Estimated ARR: ~$4.8M annual (net of prepay/discounts)

Option 2 — Dedicated Capacity (recommended if they need predictable 95p latency <250ms during peaks):
- Reserved GPU pools sized for 1200 t/s peak windows; monthly platform fee + token consumption at reduced unit ($0.00030/token after capacity offsets)
- Term: 12 months; includes burst pool for short windows

Commercial notes:
- We will include a phased true-up clause (quarterly) and a performance SLA tied to availability/latency with credits for miss
- Payment terms: standard Net30; 50% upfront for initial onboarding for Dedicated deals is typical depending on finance approval

Related links: hubspot deal and preliminary quote will reference DEAL-2026-1157.

If that looks good, I can prepare the DocuSign quote (hosted commit + optional dedicated SOW) and send to Jordan. Marcus — confirm finance approval for the prepay 5% stack.

— Ben
